description: Hallmark's edit-time lint (Nutlope/hallmark, MIT; the vendored skill of the built-in kit hallmark): after each Write, Edit or MultiEdit, sloplint checks the written file if it is a Hallmark page (.html, .css; .jsx, .tsx, .vue, .svelte, .astro in a project with a .hallmark folder) and adds its Floor failures as context. Local only: it reads the file and runs node, nothing else. Without the kit hallmark it prints {} and does nothing.

hooks.command: f=/root/.claude/skills/hallmark/scripts/lint-hook.mjs; if [ -f "$f" ]; then exec node "$f"; else echo '{}'; fi
